numerical_candidate.planning_limits: Independent equal-variance raw-mean approximation only. Family counts all15 targets and all6 control executions across the two CI suites. Native calibration determines actual sensitivity; no universal power guarantee.
numerical_candidate.degenerate_rule_candidate: For the reviewed local experiment, only validated identical pooled native integer support with both counts>10000 uses the exact absolute-mean permutation upper-tail p=1. Equal-distribution/exchangeability null and class-independent measurement assumptions remain explicit. Unequal constants, floating aliases, one-class variance zero and sparse samples remain ineligible.
numerical_candidate.continuous_rule: Existing Welch fractional-df calculation retained for sufficiently populated positive-variance statistics, subject to its assumptions.
numerical_candidate.eligibility: All 102 records and full schedule remain mandatory; insufficient counts, invalid support, numerical failure or absent controls remain non-admissible.
numerical_candidate.crop_membership: tick <= frozen empirical pilot quantile; include complete integer ties, with all100 statistics and observed-count floors retained
